def matrix_free_spectral_embedding(
    counts: np.ndarray,
    n_components: int,
    random_state: int = 0,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return leading spectral coordinates for a cell-by-feature count matrix."""
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts must be finite")
    if np.any(counts < 0):
        raise ValueError("counts must be nonnegative")
    if np.any(np.all(counts == 0, axis=1)):
        raise ValueError("counts must not have all-zero rows")
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be between 1 and n_cells - 1 inclusive")
    col_sums = np.sum(counts, axis=0)
    row_sums_similarity = counts @ col_sums  # shape (n_cells,)
    D_inv_sqrt = 1.0 / np.sqrt(row_sums_similarity)
    from scipy.sparse.linalg import LinearOperator, eigsh
    def matvec(v):
        a = v * D_inv_sqrt
        b = counts.T @ a
        c = counts @ b
        d = c * D_inv_sqrt
        return d
    op = LinearOperator((n_cells, n_cells), matvec=matvec, dtype=counts.dtype)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.normal(size=n_cells)
    v0 = v0 / np.linalg.norm(v0)
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(op, k=n_components, which='LM', v0=v0)
    idx = np.argsort(eigenvalues)[::-1]
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[idx]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, idx]
    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
